key_idea: Keep the set of empty pads in an ordered set; a jump is upper_bound(current position), then swap the frog's old pad into the set.
sketch: Positions never exceed 1e6+q, so initialise an ordered set with all empty pads up to 1.3e6. For each jump of frog i find the smallest empty pad greater than x_i, erase it, insert x_i, update x_i and print. O((M+q) log M). A DSU 'next free' does not work directly because pads become free again; the set handles that. Build the set with hinted inserts to keep it fast.
